text:
Here are some of the best-reviewed florists in Dallas, based on the sources I found. Ratings and details can change, so check hours before you go.

**Top-rated by reviews**
- **McShan Florist** (Garland Road, near White Rock Lake) has a 4.9 rating from 4,931 reviews on [exa.ai](https://exa.ai/library/places?ids=qd9w1r63gnk%2Cb9kryhjy9fk%2Cg6y6xwrkklj%2Cqzjnr441ptt%2Cz0fs3ccdz4t%2C72tyd0h1fkl%2C1qxfm3m0m96%2C82fb2bkgxzz%2Csz1yqz9wfnl%2C98ybr9j1xdy). It was founded in 1948, and [thursd.com](https://thursd.com/articles/the-best-flower-shops-to-visit-in-dallas) recommends it for sympathy flowers, gift baskets, corporate orders, and delivery across the city.
- **Dr. Delphinium** (5806 W. Lovers Ln.) has a 4.7 rating from 765 reviews on [exa.ai](https://exa.ai/library/places?ids=qd9w1r63gnk%2Cb9kryhjy9fk%2Cg6y6xwrkklj%2Cqzjnr441ptt%2Cz0fs3ccdz4t%2C72tyd0h1fkl%2C1qxfm3m0m96%2C82fb2bkgxzz%2Csz1yqz9wfnl%2C98ybr9j1xdy). [dmagazine.com](https://www.dmagazine.com/guides/the-best-floral-shops-in-dallas/) says its arrangements run about $65 to $600, and it offers weddings, subscriptions, and classes. Some classes are taught by Jenny Thomasson, a 2022 Interflora World Cup winner.

**Best for statement arrangements and events**
- **Avant Garden** (4254A Oak Lawn Ave., Highland Park) is known for full, over-the-top centerpieces. Arrangements start at $115, and it offers a six-month subscription. [dmagazine.com](https://www.dmagazine.com/guides/the-best-floral-shops-in-dallas/) notes it also does weddings and intimate dinners.
- **Cebolla** is described by [papercitymag.com](https://www.papercitymag.com/fashion/shopping/best-unique-flowers-dallas/) as a longstanding Dallas shop known for European-style arrangements and statement pieces.

**Best for walk-ins and same-day orders**
- **DIRT Flowers** (211 E. Colorado Blvd.) moved in 2025 to a larger shop in North Oak Cliff. It is open seven days a week and takes walk-ins and same-day orders, and [thursd.com](https://thursd.com/articles/the-best-flower-shops-to-visit-in-dallas) says it delivers on Sundays. [dmagazine.com](https://www.dmagazine.com/guides/the-best-floral-shops-in-dallas/) notes it offers deliveries seven days a week.
- **Le Bloom** (4152 Travis St.) started as a flower cart on Knox Street and now has a shop that also sells coffee. Weekend bouquets are about $25 and sell out early, so [thursd.com](https://thursd.com/articles/the-best-flower-shops-to-visit-in-dallas) suggests going before 11 a.m. Saturday or 9 a.m. Sunday.

**Best for a browsing experience**
- **Grey Gardens** (1900 S. Harwood St., Cedars) is in a renovated 1920s pharmacy. You can pick your own loose stems, and it also does events and destination weddings. [dmagazine.com](https://www.dmagazine.com/guides/the-best-floral-shops-in-dallas/) recommends checking its Instagram before visiting, since hours vary.
- **The T Shop** (6342 La Vista Dr., Lakewood) is a florist and gift shop that offers free delivery within 15 miles. Arrangements start around $100, and it also teaches classes. [dmagazine.com](https://www.dmagazine.com/guides/the-best-floral-shops-in-dallas/) covers it.

**Best for custom subscriptions**
- **Park City Petals** (6445 Cedar Springs Rd.) offers weekly, biweekly, or monthly arrangement subscriptions. Arrangements start at $135, and it delivers Monday through Friday. You can't browse in person. [dmagazine.com](https://www.dmagazine.com/guides/the-best-floral-shops-in-dallas/) covers it.

For a wedding, [dmagazine.com](https://www.dmagazine.com/guides/the-best-floral-shops-in-dallas/) highlights Dr. Delphinium and Avant Garden, and [peerspace.com](https://www.peerspace.com/resources/wedding-florists-in-dallas/) has a separate list of wedding florists, though the excerpt I found didn't name them.

Several guides and review sites name the same shops, so these are the most consistently recommended picks. Rankings vary, so the best choice depends on what you need.

**Design-forward and luxury**
- **Avant Garden** (Todd Fiscus): It is known for full, over-the-top centerpieces and European-style arrangements, and the shop also sells pottery, candles, and other home goods. It's at 4254A Oak Lawn Ave, Dallas, TX 75219 (The Shops of Highland Park).
- **Cebolla:** Cebolla is synonymous with fine flowers in Dallas. The longstanding floral shop is known for its European-style arrangements and stunning statement pieces.
- **Dr. Delphinium:** Its arrangements range from $65 to around $600, and it also offers a weekly and monthly flower subscription, or book them for your wedding. It has locations at 5806 W. Lovers Ln., Dallas; 513 W. Campbell Rd., Richardson.
- **Billie Ball Co:** Known for weddings and special events, but it also does earthy arrangements for the home.

**Established and reliable for delivery**
- **McShan Florist:** Lee and Velma McShan bought land on what was then a rural stretch of Garland Road and opened McShan Florist in 1948. It is the most experienced name on this list, and a safe pick for sympathy flowers, gift baskets, and delivery anywhere in the area.
- **Yelp's top-ranked shops** include In Bloom Flowers on Mockingbird, Lane Florist, Estrella's Flower Shop, Park Cities Petals, Petals & Stems Florist, Lake Highlands Flowers, Mille Fleurs Flowers, Designs East Florist. Reviews are the main source for these, so check recent ones.

**Unique and boutique**
- **DIRT** (Bishop Arts): Located in Bishop Arts off Oak Cliff, DIRT is an adorable shop with seasonal, hand-picked arrangements by in-house florists!
- **Twelve Thirty Four** (Swiss Avenue): Patricio Rivera started Twelve Thirty Four as a floral service in 2016, and in 2024 he opened his first shop in a 1920s storefront on Swiss Avenue.
- **The T Shop** (Lakewood): The spot has cheerful, vibrant mixes of seasonal blooms starting around $100. They offer free deliveries within 15 miles of the shop.
- **PRESCH Petals** (Design District): The shop makes flowers for everyday occasions and events, and it offers classes and flower subscriptions.
- **Floral Bar** (Southlake): Known for maximalist arrangements, overflowing with painted fronds, feathers, anthurium, and lush petals.

**Quick picks by need**
- Special occasion or centerpieces: Avant Garden or Cebolla
- Sympathy or reliable delivery: McShan Florist
- Budget-friendly: The T Shop, or check McShan's pricing
- Classes or subscriptions: Dr. Delphinium or PRESCH Petals

Some sites in the results, like UpFlorist and Petal Republic, are delivery services that route orders to local florists rather than shops themselves. Call the shop directly to confirm hours, delivery areas, and availability for your date.
